assessment_summary: VALIDATION APPROACH: Inspected the installation summary, then independently verified each guide requirement through live evidence rather than trusting the summary. (1) Confirmed both prerequisites via process/port inspection: nginx 1.18 on :80 with PHP-FPM FastCGI config, and ES 7.17.28 on 127.0.0.1:9200 with green cluster health and CORS enabled for http://localhost. (2) Verified deployment completeness by diffing the source repo (/workspace) against the web docroot (/var/www/html): all guide-mandated folders (config, externalPackages, i18n, src, php), the toplevel data/ folder, top-level HTML pages, and the examples tree are present with no missing or altered content files; HTTP status checks confirmed all pages and index.html assets serve 200. (3) Verified configuration: baseConfig.json matches the live deployment (direct mode, correct base URL); CORS proven with real browser-style preflight and Origin-attached POST. (4) Performed an independent end-to-end browser test (own Playwright/Chromium scripts, not reusing installer scripts) driving the main explorer page: index list populated from live ES, mapping loaded, filter values (artist names) fetched via live ES aggregation, and a full search executed that rendered an SVG bar chart. The chart's rendered values were cross-checked against a direct ES aggregation on spotify_tracks and matched exactly (6 docs, per-artist counts), proving the complete data path browser → JS app → Elasticsearch → visualization works. (5) Verified the PHP proxy path executes real queries under its documented envelope protocol. LIMITATIONS/CAVEATS: KOSIS example dataset not imported (guide only requires copying pages + data folder, both satisfied; example pages serve 200); the komono page has one 404'd resource but still loads and renders; the PHP proxy returns 400 on non-envelope bodies (by-design protocol) and has a shipped-code empty-JSON-object quirk in proxy mode only — the default direct mode is unaffected and fully functional; services run without systemd (container context, all verified running at validation time). None of these limitations impede the core installation or the guide's stated functionality. CONCLUSION: Objective evidence demonstrates the installation is complete per the guide and the software is operational end-to-end.
